results.name: Barbell Full Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back. Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Begin the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees, lowering your body until your thighs are slightly below than parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to return to the starting position, extending your hips and knees fully. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your chest up and back straight to maintain proper posture and alignment.
Focus on driving through your heels to engage your glutes and quadriceps effectively.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you stand up and inhaling as you lower down.
results.description: Barbell Full Squat is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Lower Back.

results.name: Barbell Hang Clean
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, bend at your hips and knees to grip the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Hold the barbell against your thighs.

Begin the exercise by hinging at the hips, lowering the barbell to knee level, then explosively extend your hips and knees, lightly jumping, while shrugging your shoulders and pulling the barbell up to your chest level.
Swiftly rotate your elbows underneath the bar and catch it across the front of your shoulders in a partial squat.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the barbell close to your body throughout the entire movement.
Generate power from your hips and legs rather than pulling with your arms, landing on soft knees during the catch.
Engage your core to support your lower back and maintain stability throughout the movement.
Exhale during the explosive pull and inhale as you reset for the next repetition.
results.description: Barbell Hang Clean is an advanced multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Quadriceps, Hamstrings.

results.name: Barbell Muscle Clean
instructions: Begin in a squatted position with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing your body), hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. The barbell should be resting on the floor.

Explosively extend your hips and knees while pulling the barbell up towards your chest, keeping it close to your body. As the barbell passes your knees, shrug your shoulders and continue to pull the barbell upward.
Quickly rotate your elbows under the bar and catch it in a front rack position with your elbows pointing forward. Stand up straight to complete the lift.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the barbell close to your body to ensure an efficient and powerful lift.
Focus on an explosive hip extension to generate the necessary force for the clean.
Engage your shoulders and traps during the shrug to assist in lifting the barbell.
Use your legs and hips rather than relying solely on your arms to lift the barbell.
results.description: Barbell Muscle Clean is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Biceps.

results.name: Barbell Power Clean From Blocks
instructions: Position the barbell on blocks set just below knee height. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding the barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing your body), hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.

Begin the lift by explosively extending your hips and knees while pulling the barbell up towards your chest, keeping it close to your body. As the barbell passes your knees, shrug your shoulders and continue to pull the barbell upward.
Quickly rotate your elbows under the bar and catch it in a front rack position with your elbows pointing forward. Stand up straight to complete the lift.
Lower the barbell back to the blocks with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on an explosive hip extension to generate the necessary force for the clean.
Engage your shoulders and traps during the shrug to assist in lifting the barbell.
Use your legs and hips rather than relying solely on your arms to lift the barbell.
Practice the movement with lighter weights to perfect your form before progressing to heavier loads.
results.description: Barbell Power Clean From Blocks is an advanced multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Biceps.

results.name: Barbell Power Jerk
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. The barbell should rest on your front deltoids and clavicles.
Slightly bend your knees to dip into a quarter squat position while keeping your chest up and maintaining a neutral spine.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles to drive the barbell overhead.
Stand up fully to complete the lift. Lower the barbell back to shoulder height with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your chest up and shoulders engaged to maintain proper posture and control of the barbell.
Practice the movement with lighter weights to perfect your form before progressing to heavier loads.
Use a slight dip to generate power for the overhead push, ensuring your movement is quick and controlled.
results.description: Barbell Power Jerk is an advanced multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Calves.

results.name: Barbell Power Snatch
instructions: Begin in a squatted position with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell with a wide grip (palms facing your body), hands wider than shoulder-width apart. The barbell should be resting on the floor.

Explosively extend your hips and knees while pulling the barbell up towards your chest, keeping it close to your body. As the barbell passes your knees, shrug your shoulders and continue to pull the barbell upward.
Quickly rotate your elbows under the bar and catch it in a wide overhead position with your elbows fully extended and your body in a partial squat. Stand up straight to complete the lift.
Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on an explosive hip extension to generate the necessary force for the snatch.
Engage your shoulders and traps during the shrug to assist in lifting the barbell.
Use your legs and hips rather than relying solely on your arms to lift the barbell.
results.description: Barbell Power Snatch is an advanced multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back, Forearms, Biceps.

results.name: Barbell Press Under
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold the barbell across the back of your shoulders with a wide grip.
Press the barbell overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Lower your body into a squat while keeping the barbell locked out overhead, pause for 1-2 seconds.
Return to the starting position by pressing through your heels. Reset and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your arms fully extended while the barbell is overhead.
Keep your chest up and your core engaged throughout the movement for stability.
Keep your heels flat on the floor throughout the squat.
Inhale deeply before moving into the squat and exhale as you stand back up.
results.description: Barbell Press Under is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Hamstrings, Core.

results.name: Barbell Rack Pull
instructions: Position a barbell on a rack set to just below knee height. Stand with your feet hip-width apart, and grip the barbell with an overhand grip (palms facing your body), hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Begin the lift by driving through your heels, extending your hips and knees to lift the barbell.
Pull the barbell up your legs until you reach a standing position with your shoulders back and hips fully extended. Keep the barbell close to your body throughout the movement.
Lower the barbell back to the rack with control by hinging at your hips and bending your knees. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep the barbell close to your body to ensure an efficient and powerful lift.
Focus on engaging your glutes and hamstrings during the hip extension.
Use a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise to prevent strain or injury.
results.description: Barbell Rack Pull is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Quadriceps, Upper Back.

results.name: Barbell Snatch Balance
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back with an overhand grip, hands placed wider than shoulder-width apart. Your feet should be in a slight squat stance.
Dip slightly by bending your knees and hips, then quickly drive upwards, extending your knees and hips.
As you extend, use the upward momentum to press the barbell overhead while simultaneously dropping into a deep squat position, catching the barbell with your arms fully extended overhead.
Stand up by extending your hips and knees, keeping the barbell overhead. Lower the barbell back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Explode through your hips and knees to generate the power needed for the lift.
Drop quickly into the squat to catch the barbell overhead in a stable position.
Use a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise to prevent strain or injury.
results.description: Barbell Snatch Balance is an advanced multi-joint compound static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the balance category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Upper Back, Lower Back.
